{{Top|leg}}
'''Hengin Ki-Tapp Wett Gon-far''' was a [[Gazar]] tree-[[City/Legends|city]] built in the rainsforests of [[Veron Minor]]. Located on the southeastern coast of the [[Vusl]] continent, and while it wasn't the largest city of the Gazaran, it was one of the most powerful. The city controlled the nearby [[Treblio spaceport]], strictly regulating what business the other cities could do in that area. The city had a population of over 100,000 Gazaran.
